text:
Maya R (Product): quick q — my partner and I are expecting via surrogacy in September. I plan to take 8 weeks parental leave at 50% FTE starting ~2024-09-02. Can I do intermittent schedule (Mon-Wed onsite, Thu-Fri remote part-time) and still receive the top-up? also any paperwork specifics for surrogacy?
Liam C (People Ops): congrats! we allow part-time schedules during parental leave with manager approval. top-up eligibility: full-time employees on approved leave >= 30 days can get up to 6 weeks of Redwood top-up (supplemental pay). intermittent schedules are allowed but must be in the leave plan. please file the Parental Leave Request form and indicate work pattern. cc @Priya K for manager sign-off.
Priya K (Eng Manager): i'm fine with the proposed Mon-Wed onsite / Thu-Fri 50% if Maya commits to core overlap 11-3. i'll sign the form once dates are exact.
Maya R (Product): thanks — two follow-ups: 1) does the top-up require pre-tax deferral adjustments? 2) surrogacy paperwork — we have the agency docs and court order pending. are those sufficient?
payroll-bot: FYI — top-up is processed as regular payroll (subject to tax & benefit deductions). Steps to get top-up:
```
1) Employee submits "Parental Leave Request" form (select "Top-up request")
2) Manager approves in workflow
3) People Ops verifies leave docs (surrogacy affidavit / placement letter / court order)
4) Payroll applies TOPUP code and adjusts withholdings per standard payroll cycle
```
payroll-bot: note — if you contribute to a pre-tax benefit (401k, HSA), the top-up goes through payroll and will be subject to normal pretax rules; you can change elections before the payroll cut if needed.
Benefits Team: surrogacy docs accepted: agency placement + state filing or court order. if court order pending at time of leave start, we accept placement letter + proof of payment to agency and then final court docs when available. benefits remain active during 50% leave; dependent premium share stays the same.
Maya R (Product): great. what about international payroll? i'll be on parental leave while traveling to my partner's home country for 3 weeks — will payroll/top-up work the same?
Liam C (People Ops): international pay gotchas — if you're receiving pay while physically outside the US, tax residency & payroll withholding could be affected. if travel >14 days outside US during leave, notify payroll and run the "Cross-border leave notification": https://intranet.redwood/payroll/cross-border. payroll will confirm whether we can process the top-up or need local payroll.
Priya K (Eng Manager): i'll approve the intermittent schedule conditionally. Maya, please stick to the documented handoff and weekly async updates so oncall isn't impacted.
Maya R (Product): will do. one last thing — equipment: do I return laptop during leave or keep it?
Liam C (People Ops): keep it. loaner policy only applies for >6 month leaves or if you're relocating for >90 days to a different country and local law requires it. ensure asset checklist is up to date before leave.
Maya R (Product): filled the Parental Leave Request form and uploaded placement letter. submitted for Priya approval. thanks all!
Priya K (Eng Manager): approved in form. :white_check_mark:
Liam C (People Ops): verified docs. payroll notified. Maya, expect top-up on first payroll after leave start; payroll will DM you if they need additional tax forms.
Benefits Team: noted — we'll send a benefits confirmation email with FSA/401k impact summary.
Maya R (Product): awesome — appreciate the quick help. :heart:
